skill.name: sop-code-review
skill.description: A structured code review SOP that coordinates automated checks, specialist reviewers, integration assessment, and final PR decisions.
skill.summary: Coordinate staged pull request reviews across quality, security, performance, architecture, documentation, and release risk.

content.value_statement: Large reviews can miss security, performance, and documentation issues. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a staged multi-agent review workflow.
actual_capabilities: Defines a four-phase review timeline for automated checks, specialist reviews, integration review, and final approval.
Coordinates linting, tests, coverage, and build validation as first-pass quality gates.
Assigns focused review prompts for code quality, security, performance, architecture, and documentation.
Aggregates specialist feedback into blocking issues, high-priority suggestions, and optional improvements.
Guides final PR decisions for approval, change requests, or rejection.
limitations: It is a workflow prompt, not a standalone CI runner or scanner.
It depends on available agent and MCP tooling in the user environment.
It does not provide language-specific commands or repository-specific policies.
Review timing and coverage targets may need adjustment for each team.

use_cases.title: Standardize Pull Request Reviews
use_cases.description: Apply the same quality, test, security, and approval gates to every important PR.

use_cases.title: Add Specialist Review Coverage
use_cases.description: Split review work across focused quality, security, performance, architecture, and documentation checks.

use_cases.title: Prepare Release-Critical Changes
use_cases.description: Assess deployment impact, rollback readiness, user impact, and merge risk before release.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Pull Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single PR
prompt_templates.prompt: Use sop-code-review to review PR [number] in [repository]. Focus on automated checks, security, performance, architecture, and documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Run Specialist Reviews
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review with separate reviewer tracks
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply sop-code-review to these changes: [summary]. Produce separate quality, security, performance, architecture, and documentation findings.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Release Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Use sop-code-review for PR [number]. Include deployment impact, rollback readiness, user impact, and feature flag recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Full Review Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Use sop-code-review across [repository] for [release name]. Track phase status, blocking issues, ownership, and final merge decisions.

output_examples.input: A pull request adds a new payment endpoint and updates session handling.
output: Automated checks pass, but security review finds missing authorization on refund access.
Architecture review accepts the endpoint structure after one naming change.
Final decision is request changes until the authorization gap is fixed.

output_examples.input: A feature PR changes database queries and adds user-facing UI copy.
output: Performance review flags a possible N+1 query in the list view.
Documentation review requests API notes for the changed response fields.
Final decision is conditional approval after query and documentation updates.

output_examples.input: A release branch contains several infrastructure and migration changes.
output: Deployment review asks for a clearer rollback plan and migration verification steps.
Risk analysis recommends a feature flag and production monitoring checks.
Final decision is request changes before merge to the release branch.

best_practices: Run the workflow after the PR has a clear description and test plan.
Keep blocking findings tied to specific risks and required fixes.
Tune coverage, timing, and approval gates to match repository standards.
anti_patterns: Using the workflow as a substitute for human approval on sensitive changes.
Treating every suggestion as a blocker without severity triage.
Running tests or builds against untrusted code without environment controls.

faq.question: Does this skill run tests automatically?
faq.answer: It provides a workflow for test and build checks. Actual execution depends on the host tool and user permissions.

faq.question: Can it review security issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes prompts for authentication, authorization, input validation, output encoding, secrets, and common web vulnerabilities.

faq.question: Does it replace CI?
faq.answer: No. It complements CI by organizing human and agent review around the results.

faq.question: Can teams change the review gates?
faq.answer: Yes. Teams should adjust coverage targets, timing, and approval rules to match their repository.

faq.question: Which tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted repositories?
faq.answer: Use a sandboxed environment before running builds or tests on untrusted code.
